zh.title: 鄭麗君：美對臺無人機關稅15%不疊加 優惠已上路
zh.summary: 鄭麗君表示，美國對臺無人機232關稅為15%且不疊加，優惠已上路。
body: 行政院副院長鄭麗君表示，美國對臺灣的非半導體232條款關稅優惠已經上路，其中無人機稅率為15%，採不疊加方式。
鄭麗君稱，臺灣無人機適用的稅率是全球最低。她提出的比較數字中，越南、加拿大為25%至100.17%，中國為50%至125.17%。
美國政府正依《1962年貿易擴張法》第232條，調查全球進口無人機系統（UAS）及其零組件對美國國家安全的影響。
鄭麗君另說，用於航空零組件的鋼、鋁、銅，232條款關稅為零，僅課最惠國待遇（MFN）關稅。

en.title: Taiwan says U.S. tariff on its drones applies at 15% without stacking
en.summary: Taiwan says U.S. tariff relief on its drones is in force at a non-stacking 15% rate.
body: Taiwan Vice Premier 鄭麗君 said U.S. Section 232 tariff concessions for Taiwan on non-semiconductor products have taken effect. The rate for drones is 15% on a non-stacking basis.
She described Taiwan's drone rate as the lowest globally. For comparison, she cited a range of 25% to 100.17% for Vietnam and Canada, and 50% to 125.17% for China.

The U.S. government is investigating the national security impact of imports of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and their components from around the world under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962.
She also said steel, aluminum and copper used in aviation components carry no Section 232 tariff, with only most-favored-nation (MFN) duties applying.

facts.sourceQuote: 行政院副院長鄭麗君今天說，美國對台灣非半導體232關稅優惠已經上路，包含汽車零組件、木材及其製品、無人機15%不疊加等
